def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

from collections import deque
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==5 and not seen[i][j]:
                comp=[]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and g[na][nb]==5 and not seen[na][nb]:
                            seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
                rs=[a for a,b in comp]; cs=[b for a,b in comp]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
                # zeros inside bbox
                holes=[(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if g[a][b]==0]
                if not holes: continue
                for a,b in holes: out[a][b]=2
                top=min(a for a,b in holes)
                tops=[b for a,b in holes if a==top]
                tc=tops[0]
                left=sum(1 for a,b in holes if b<tc); right=sum(1 for a,b in holes if b>tc)
                # line goes opposite the deeper side
                if left>right: dr=-1
                elif right>left: dr=1
                else: dr=-1
                row=top-1
                if 0<=row<H:
                    if dr==-1:
                        for b in range(0,tc+1): out[row][b]=2
                    else:
                        for b in range(tc,W): out[row][b]=2
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
